title: Air Fryer Fish Tacos with Lime Slaw
description: Spiced white fish from the air fryer in soft tortillas, with a crunchy lime slaw and a quick lime yoghurt sauce.

confidence.note: Built from technique. Not yet cooked; the air fryer time suits fillets about 2cm thick.

steps.title: Season the fish
steps.text: Pat the fish ({{fish}}) very dry with paper towel. Toss with the olive oil ({{oil}}), smoked paprika ({{smoked-paprika}}), cumin ({{cumin}}), garlic powder ({{garlic-powder}}) and salt ({{salt}}).

steps.title: Shred the slaw
steps.text: Add the cabbage ({{cabbage}}) and carrot ({{carrot}}) to the bowl. Shred 4 sec / Speed 4, in two batches if the bowl is more than half full. Or shred finely by hand.

steps.title: Dress the slaw
steps.text: Toss the slaw with the coriander ({{coriander}}), the lime zest, half the lime juice and the salt ({{slaw-salt}}).

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Stir the yoghurt ({{yoghurt}}) and mayonnaise ({{mayo}}) with the rest of the lime juice and hot sauce to taste.

steps.title: Air fry
steps.text: Lay the fish in a single layer in the basket, not touching. Air fry at 200°C for 8–10 minutes, turning gently halfway, until it flakes easily.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Warm the tortillas ({{tortillas}}) in the air fryer for 30–60 seconds once the fish is out, or in a dry pan.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Fill each tortilla with slaw, fish and avocado ({{avocado}}), then spoon the sauce over. Eat straight away.

notes.title: Crumbed version
notes.text: Dip the strips in flour, then beaten egg, then panko mixed with the spices. Spray with oil and air fry at 200°C for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway.

notes.title: Fish choice
notes.text: Choose a firm fish that holds together. Delicate fish such as whiting or dory breaks up when turned; cook it without turning and lift it out with a spatula.

notes.title: Frozen fish
notes.text: Thaw overnight in the fridge, or in its sealed bag under cold water for about 30 minutes. Pat very dry, or it steams instead of browning.

notes.title: Crowding
notes.text: Cook in two batches if needed. Crowded fish steams and sticks.
